title: MediScan
tagline: MediScan allows facial verification of those who may be undocumented or missing documents at the time of crisis, but with the consent of the user.

prizes.placement: Top 5 - Best App Built on Leo
prizes.title: Aleo

description: On the backend, we use image recognition to pair faces with health data and a unique ID stored in a smart contract. This unique ID can then be used by anyone to send money to that person. Verified personnel can take a picture of a person and get the associated health data by that image.
how_its_made:
This project uses IPFS to store health data, Aave GHO stablecoin to send payments to faces, and AI image recognition to recognize the face and store the unique ID. We use Solidity to build our smart contracts and deploy them to multiple blockchains, to make this as widely available as possible.
We have an Aleo smart contract as well that stores the unique IDs that we deployed on the Aleo testnet.
